messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — product wants to run price-sheet PSV4 experiment with a 180-day 'legacy shield' so existing customers keep monthly promo credits. Need implementation details for invoices and reconciliation.
Evan Brooks: Proposal: add a distinct invoice line 'Legacy Shield Credit' with credit_code LSHIELD-180 and promo_id so finance can filter.
Sofia Martinez: Yes. Example CSV: customer_id,invoice_id,credit_code,promo_id,amount,notes
C-9001,inv-2026-06-01,LSHIELD-180,PSV4-2026-05,-150,legacy_shield_applied
Jared Kim: Reserved customers with committed discounts: apply committed_discount first, then shield credit up to remaining balance. No negative invoices.
billing-bot: recon-scan: sample 200 legacy accounts -> predicted disputes=2, net_revenue_impact=-$6,800. Report /recon/report/2034
Sofia Martinez: Mid-cycle prorate: prorate by days remaining, include prorate_factor in invoice metadata.
Maya Chen: Vendor pass-through: if shield reduces our bill, vendors may expect adjustment. Vendor Ops: what's default?
Vendor Ops: Most vendors require separate offset entries. Default plan: do NOT reduce vendor pass-through automatically; only if vendor opt-in flag true, then create vendor adjustment entries. That reduces churn.
Evan Brooks: For experiment tracking: use experiment_id EXP-PSV4-2026-05 on invoices and produce a shield_audit_<date>.csv mapping original->applied credits.
Sofia Martinez: SQL to tag accounts: UPDATE customers SET price_experiment='PSV4-2026-05', shielded=TRUE WHERE signup_date < '2025-12-31' AND account_tier='standard';
Maya Chen: Approvers: Sofia (Billing Lead), Evan (Revenue Ops), Vendor Ops rep. Timeline: canary 5% on 2026-06-07, monitor 7 days, full roll 2026-06-21 if OK. Rollback: revert price-sheet and issue reversal credits code LSHIELD-REVOKE.
FinOps Approvals: Gate metrics: disputes > 0.4% OR chargebacks > 3 -> auto-hold. Please confirm by EOD.
billing-bot: alert-configured: disputed_invoices_count, chargebacks_last_7d, net_revenue_delta_pct. Daily digest will post.
Jared Kim: Also add a reconcile job to emit shield_audit_<date>.csv with columns customer_id,invoice_id,original_credit_amount,applied_credit_amount,prorate_factor,experiment_id.
Sofia Martinez: I'll open PR for price-sheet schema bump and add invoice export fields. Runbook + reconciliation steps coming.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. @Vendor Ops please confirm opt-in status by 5pm PST. If no veto, proceed with canary next Friday. :rocket:
